description: Implement accessibility improvements, enhanced health API, SECURITY.md, and DemoContent useCallback fix for better code quality, security policy, and accessibility compliance.
steps: Add SECURITY.md to repository root with responsible disclosure policy
Enhance health API to include version from package.json and process uptime
Add visible focus ring to demo stepper container in DemoContent.tsx
Add aria-label attributes to social links in ContactContent.tsx
Wrap goNext/goPrev in useCallback in DemoContent.tsx for correctness
acceptance_criteria: SECURITY.md exists at repo root with disclosure instructions
Health API returns status, timestamp, version, and uptime fields
Demo stepper div has focus-visible:outline classes for visible keyboard focus
All social links in ContactContent have descriptive aria-label attributes
goNext and goPrev are wrapped in useCallback in DemoContent.tsx
verification: Run npm run build and confirm no errors
Run npm run lint and confirm no lint errors
findings: The health API route became dynamic (server-rendered on demand) because process.uptime() changes per request. The package.json import via @/package.json works thanks to resolveJsonModule: true in tsconfig. All Tailwind v4 focus-visible utilities work correctly without additional configuration.
